[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
In `validate_v0_item`, a `KnowledgeItem` has `source_scope = "legacy"` instead of `SOURCE_SCOPE_V0_ONLY`. What should happen?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} has source_scope={}", item.id, item.source_scope))`. V0 retrieval must remain scoped to `v0_only`.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A `KnowledgeItem` passes `source_scope`, but `legacy_allowed = true`. What should `validate_v0_item` do?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} allows legacy context", item.id))`. V0 items must not allow legacy context.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
`item.layer.is_v0_runtime_layer()` returns false for a knowledge item under V0 retrieval. What should happen?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} has disallowed layer {}", item.id, item.layer.as_str()))`. Only V0 runtime layers are permitted.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A V0 knowledge item has `source_path` outside `DEFAULT_V0_ROOT`. What should `validate_v0_item` return?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} source_path outside V0 root: {}", item.id, item.source_path))`.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=major]
A `KnowledgeItem` has `source_scope = SOURCE_SCOPE_V0_ONLY`, `legacy_allowed = false`, `layer.is_v0_runtime_layer() = true`, and `source_path` starts with `DEFAULT_V0_ROOT`. What should `validate_v0_item` return?
Accept. The item satisfies all current V0 retrieval guardrails.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A knowledge item has both `legacy_allowed = true` and a `source_path` outside `DEFAULT_V0_ROOT`. Which guardrail violation should `validate_v0_item` return first?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} allows legacy context", item.id))`. The legacy-context guard runs before the source-path check.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A knowledge item has `source_scope != SOURCE_SCOPE_V0_ONLY` and `legacy_allowed = true`. Which violation should current `validate_v0_item` return first?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} has source_scope={}", item.id, item.source_scope))`. Source-scope validation runs before the legacy-allowed guard.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=major]
One default guardrail says: `No legacy docs in V0 RAG/MCP retrieval.` What protocol-level meaning should the model preserve from that rule?
V0 retrieval must not silently mix in legacy context. Knowledge used for V0 runtime assistance should stay within V0-only sources and not degrade into legacy-document grounding.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=major]
One forbidden inference says: `Do not infer current code reality from product direction docs.` How should the model behave when direction docs and current code status might diverge?
Do not promote direction material into present-tense implementation facts. Treat product-direction docs as intent, not as proof of current code reality.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=major]
A retrieval helper suggests using docs outside `DEFAULT_V0_ROOT` because they are semantically similar to the user query. Is that acceptable under the current V0 guardrail design?
No. Semantic similarity does not override the V0 root boundary. Retrieval must stay inside the approved V0 source root and scope.
